projects.title: Transportation Graph Path Search Course Project
bullets: Constructed graphs from public route tables using Python and NetworkX as part of a supervised undergraduate course project on multimodal transit networks.
Implemented shortest-path queries and tested disconnected graph cases, contributing to the course team's work on public transportation graph path search.

research.title: Supervised Bus Network Path Search Research
bullets: Constructed graphs from public route tables using Python and NetworkX as a student research assistant in supervised research on urban bus networks.
Implemented shortest-path queries and tested disconnected graph cases as assigned contributions to supervised research on path search in public transportation graphs.
